separate_older_active_research.p13_outcome: D-optimal active probes lost to same-budget random probes in known lag worlds
separate_older_active_research.scope: P51 compares causal rank repair in nonalternating policy histories, not new claim of universal active exploration or novelty over P13

hypothesis: Given six already-completed actions from a potentially confounded feedback/sticky/constant policy and only two further factual actions, can greedily residualizing the prospective executed action against a quadratic nuisance basis recover identifiability and reduce the final current-causal-effect error relative to equal two-probe random, last-action reversal, and a conventional D-optimal selector?

source.kind: fresh openly authored simulated DEV worlds, not authentic independent owner science
source.latent_effect: equiprobable sign * uniform(.25,.45), except zero-effect sham = exactly 0
source.causal_reverse: flip effect sign starting at k uniform integer{3,4,5} on causal worlds
source.nuisance_jump: independent signed step with |step| uniform(.4,.7) starting at k uniform{3,4,5}
source.uncontrolled_action_policy: first 6 completed actual actions: constant sign, feedback(-sign of past sensor) with 20% random exploration, 80%-sticky prior actual action, or 50/50 fair random; all use only previously realized observation and policy RNG
source.matched_source: All probe-arm clones share the same 6 actual action-outcome facts, latent physical world, and exogenous/noise arrays for every t; their own two executed probe actions create different actual observed states. No alternative never-executed outcome shown.
source.probe_budget: Every arm executes exactly 2 real interventions at t=6 and 7; no source world receives extra probes, labels, future outcomes or special thresholds
source.action_signs: Both -1/+1 permitted, no forced naturalness limits.

probes.candidate_orthogonal: greedily choose +1/-1 maximizing squared residual of prospective action column after projecting it against [1,t,t^2] on all completed facts and the proposed current action; identical before/after action history for alternatives except proposed factual action; tie -> last-action reversal
probes.conventional_Doptimal: greedily choose +1/-1 maximizing logdet(X^TX + 1e-4*I) with X=[1,t,t²,action] through current candidate, exact same factual history and opportunities, tie -> last-action reversal
probes.simple_flip: execute opposite of immediately previous actual action at both probe slots, no model
probes.random: seeded independent fair +/-1, no oracle, same two slots
probes.passive: continue the *same* original policy for two more completed actual events, no privileged labels
probes.source_order: precommitted sorted arm order candidate, Doptimal, flip, random, passive; all share the same independent world noise and common random values; do not accidentally consume different hidden-world randomness by policy

estimator.factual_effect_full: OLS float64 [1,t,t²,executed_action] after 8 actual actions, reject rank <4 or condition>1e6
estimator.factual_effect_recent: OLS float64 [1,t,executed_action] on final 3 completed facts, reject rank <3 or condition>1e6
estimator.rank_deficient: NaN, explicit abstention, count as missing; for main score missing incurs fixed 1.0 absolute-effect error
estimator.no_effect_sham: report absolute fitted false effect and identifiable fraction
estimator.observation_memory: 8 actual pairs only; deterministic cold replay from serialized facts, no model or source secret

metrics.information_coverage: overall and by initial policy, for full8 and last3
metrics.primary: causal-switch current-effect penalized_MAE from final 3 factual outcomes, missing counts as 1.0, for every cohort and per policy
frozen_pass: candidate causal-switch penalized MAE <=0.9*min(Doptimal,random,flip) on each of 3 cohorts
candidate full rank coverage >=0.95 in constant policy in each cohort and >=random+0.10 in constant policy in each cohort
candidate sham mean abs false effect <=0.06 on identifiable last3 in each cohort
candidate no world uses unexecuted outcomes, 2 probes exactly, bit-exact cold replay
candidate whole-process wall and all comparator wall measured; if >Doptimal by >25% cannot claim efficiency
metrics.total_cost: report actual process seconds and per-arm source action count; no paid APIs, no GPU
metrics.scientific_PASS: NOT_POSSIBLE here; source is authored synthetic and not independent project-owner scientific first-use
